source.data_source: Van Driest II compressibility transformation of Karman-Schoenherr Cf(Re_theta) baseline. Reference values from NASA TMR data file cf_vandriestII.dat.
source.values_extracted_at: Re_theta = 5000 and 10000 from each ZONE in cf_vandriestII.dat
source.physics: M=5 supersonic ZPG turbulent flat plate, three iso-thermal wall temperature ratios (Tw/T_inf = 1.090, 2.725, 5.450 corresponding to Tw/Taw = 0.2, 0.5, 1.0 respectively at recovery factor 0.89).

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the plate mesh (single mesh used across all 3 Tw cases)
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: Wall-resolved compressible RANS at Re/L=15e6 reaching Re_theta=10k typically requires ~50k-200k cells in 2D with y+<0.5. Hand-set.

final_residual_U.description: Final momentum residual at end of Tw/T_inf=2.725 solve (representative middle case)
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Hand-set; compressible RANS on ZPG flat plate with iso-thermal wall routinely reaches 1e-5 over 4 decades of decay.

cf_at_retheta_10000_tw1p090.description: Local skin-friction coefficient C_f at Re_theta=10000 for cold-wall case (Tw/T_inf=1.090, Tw/Taw=0.2)
cf_at_retheta_10000_tw1p090.T_good_source: Van Driest II at Re_theta=10000, M=5, Tw/Tini=1.090: Cf=1.5380e-3 (extracted from cf_vandriestII.dat zone 2). T_good ~10% of gt to allow for turbulence-model spread (SA/SST/SSG-LRR scatter ~5-8% on Cf at supersonic conditions per TMR cross-code comparisons).

cf_at_retheta_10000_tw2p725.description: Local skin-friction coefficient C_f at Re_theta=10000 for intermediate-wall case (Tw/T_inf=2.725, Tw/Taw=0.5)
cf_at_retheta_10000_tw2p725.T_good_source: Van Driest II at Re_theta=10000, M=5, Tw/Tini=2.725: Cf=1.2199e-3 (extracted from cf_vandriestII.dat zone 3).

cf_at_retheta_10000_tw5p450.description: Local skin-friction coefficient C_f at Re_theta=10000 for warm-wall (near-adiabatic) case (Tw/T_inf=5.450, Tw/Taw=1.0)
cf_at_retheta_10000_tw5p450.T_good_source: Van Driest II at Re_theta=10000, M=5, Tw/Tini=5.450: Cf=9.327e-4 (extracted from cf_vandriestII.dat zone 4). Adiabatic-recovery limit; smallest Cf magnitude of the three.

cf_at_retheta_5000_tw2p725.description: Local skin-friction coefficient C_f at Re_theta=5000 for intermediate-wall case (anchor at lower Re_theta)
cf_at_retheta_5000_tw2p725.T_good_source: Van Driest II at Re_theta=5000, M=5, Tw/Tini=2.725: Cf=1.4060e-3 (extracted from cf_vandriestII.dat zone 3). Lower-Re_theta anchor confirms streamwise Cf decay is captured, not just one point.
